mechanism: Both drugs can prolong QT interval; moxifloxacin is a known QT-prolonging fluoroquinolone and valbenazine (a VMAT2 inhibitor) has dose-dependent QT prolongation potential.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes; use with caution in patients with cardiac risk factors, baseline QT prolongation, or concurrent QT-prolonging agents; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
